title: Tool Catalog PDF Integration — Manufacturer Data Extraction
brief: Extract structured cutting tool data from 45 manufacturer PDF catalogs (Tungaloy, Sandvik, Kennametal, ISCAR, OSG, Guhring, etc.) into PRISM's tool registry. Multi-session project: OCR/table extraction, schema mapping, validation, registry population.

phases.title: Catalog Inventory & Schema Design
phases.description: Inventory all 45 PDFs, classify by manufacturer/type (turning, milling, drilling, threading, tooling systems, workholding). Design unified tool data schema covering insert geometry, grade mapping, speed/feed recommendations, and catalog cross-references.

units.title: Catalog Inventory & Classification
units.description: Read first 5-10 pages of each PDF catalog. Classify by: manufacturer, tool type (turning/milling/drilling/threading/tooling), content type (geometry specs, grade tables, speed/feed charts, ordering info). Create inventory JSON.
exit_conditions: Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

units.title: Unified Tool Data Schema
units.description: Design TypeScript interfaces for unified tool data: InsertSpec (geometry, grade, chipbreaker, nose radius, edge prep), EndMillSpec (flutes, helix, LOC, shank), DrillSpec (point angle, margin, coolant), ThreadingSpec (pitch, form). Map to existing ToolRegistry schema.

phases.title: Tungaloy & Sandvik Extraction (Priority Catalogs)
phases.description: Extract structured data from Tungaloy GC_2023-2024 (8 PDFs: US/Global × Turning/Milling/Drilling/Tooling) and existing Sandvik-derived data. These are the highest-value catalogs with comprehensive speed/feed tables.

units.title: Tungaloy Turning Catalog Extraction
units.description: Extract from GC_2023-2024 Turning-Grooving (US + Global): insert geometries, grade recommendations by ISO material group, chipbreaker selection, speed/feed tables. Map to unified schema.
exit_conditions: Speed/feed data validated against existing strategy_db

units.title: Tungaloy Milling Catalog Extraction
units.description: Extract from GC_2023-2024 Milling (US + Global): end mill specs, indexable milling cutter geometries, grade tables, speed/feed recommendations by material group and operation.

units.title: Tungaloy Drilling Catalog Extraction
units.description: Extract from GC_2023-2024 Drilling (US + Global): drill geometries, point angles, coolant specs, peck drilling recommendations, speed/feed by material.

phases.title: Multi-Manufacturer Extraction (ISCAR, Kennametal, OSG, Guhring)
phases.description: Extract data from remaining high-priority manufacturer catalogs. Focus on unique data not already covered by Tungaloy extraction.

units.title: ISCAR Catalog Extraction
units.description: Extract from ISCAR PART 1: turning inserts, grooving/parting, threading, milling cutters. Focus on unique ISCAR grades (IC grades) and proprietary geometries (SUMO, DOVE-IQ).

units.title: Kennametal Catalog Extraction
units.description: Extract from Kennametal turning/milling/drilling catalogs: KCP grade system, KCSM/KCPM substrates, Beyond inserts, speed/feed tables.
exit_conditions: KCP grade mapping to ISO complete

units.title: OSG & Guhring Solid Carbide Extraction
units.description: Extract from OSG and Guhring catalogs: solid carbide end mills (geometries, coatings, flute counts), drills (point angles, coolant), taps (thread forms, speeds). These complement indexable data from Tungaloy/ISCAR/Kennametal.

units.title: Remaining Manufacturer Extraction
units.description: Extract from: MA Ford (end mills), SGS (solid carbide), Korloy (turning/rotating/solid), Emuge (taps/thread mills), Ingersoll (indexable), Accupro, Flash Solid, YG-1. Focus on unique geometries and grades not already covered.

phases.title: Tooling Systems & Workholding Extraction
phases.description: Extract non-cutting tool data: tool holders (BIG DAISHOWA, Haimer, REGO-FIX, CAMFIX), workholding (Orange Vise), tooling systems. These support machine profile validation and setup sheet generation.

units.title: Tool Holder & Collet System Extraction
units.description: Extract from BIG DAISHOWA, Haimer, REGO-FIX, CAMFIX catalogs: holder types (shrink fit, hydraulic, collet chuck, milling chuck), taper specs, runout specs, balance grades, max RPM ratings. Feed into MachineProfileEngine validation.
exit_conditions: RPM limits integrated with machine profiles
units.auto_close_out_reason: dispatcher-wired engine MachineProfileEngine found in corpus

units.title: Workholding Extraction
units.description: Extract from Orange Vise and related catalogs: vise specs, clamping force, jaw types, repeatability. Feed into workholding intelligence engine.
exit_conditions: Clamping force data available for setup sheets
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

phases.title: Registry Population & Validation
phases.description: Load all extracted tool data into PRISM's ToolRegistry. Cross-validate against existing strategy_db, physics engines, and known machining data. Build lookup APIs.

units.title: ToolRegistry Bulk Import
units.description: Create bulk import pipeline for ToolRegistry. Load all extracted tool data with manufacturer provenance. Handle deduplication across manufacturers (same ISO insert from multiple brands).

units.title: Cross-Validation & Quality Assurance
units.description: Validate extracted data against: existing strategy_db speeds (within 20%), physics engine predictions (Kienzle/Taylor), known machining handbooks. Flag outliers for manual review. Write integration tests.

units.title: Catalog Lookup API & Dispatcher Actions
units.description: Create dispatcher actions for tool catalog queries: tool_catalog_search (by material/operation/manufacturer), tool_catalog_recommend (best tool for job), tool_catalog_compare (side-by-side specs). Wire to calcDispatcher or new toolCatalogDispatcher.
